## Plan

`name`, `description`, `features` (containsMany StringField). Deliberately has no Price field of its own — a Plan's prices are looked up by querying Price cards that link to it (one-directional, per this realm's rollup-split rule: an unbounded/reporting relationship gets a live query, not a stored back-link on the parent). Self-hosts Product Review via its own isolated view.

### Non-goals
Does not carry billing interval or amount — that's `Price`. Does not render a public review page by itself; reviews are shown within this card's own isolated view, not as a separate storefront.

### Example
`linkedExamples` points at `Plan/enterprise-tier`, a real Enterprise-tier plan instance with features and a linked Price and Product Review.
attributes.cardDescription: A named, recurring tier of the product (e.g. "Pro", "Enterprise").
